title: Basis Questions on Redemptions on File and Late Enrollment Bonuses (Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements)
content:
**When does a late enrollment bonus on a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement earn an award allowance?**
A late enrollment bonus earns an award allowance from the points redemptions booked on the agreement. The enrollment-bonus lateness is the number of whole calendar months from the agreement's approval date to the credit date.

| Lateness | Points redemptions on file on the agreement | Award allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 6 months or more | 2 or more | 300 points |
| 6 months or more | exactly 1 | 150 points |
| 6 months or more | none | none |
| fewer than 6 months | any | none |

**Which redemptions are on file?**
Every points redemption entry booked on the agreement, whatever it was for — award tickets, upgrades and status awards alike — and whenever it was booked.

**How does the allowance act?**
It is added, in points, to the enrollment bonus as it stands after any percentage uplift has been applied and rounded — the bonus before allowances. Allowances on different grounds are added together.

**What does a bonus before allowances of 2625 points become with 3 redemptions on file and a lateness of 8 months, with no other allowance? (hypothetical)**
2625 with 300 added: 2925 points.
